ui.architect.title: Architect
ui.architect.choose_hint: Click a plot on the ground, or one of the list, to build on it. New plot marks one.
ui.architect.no_plots: No plot is near enough. Mark a new one.
ui.architect.copied: {name} copied. Ctrl+V puts it down under the mouse.
ui.architect.edit_keys: WASD or the arrows move the picked piece, Z+W and Z+S raise and lower it, Q and E turn it (Shift for small steps), F lets it fall to the floor, Ctrl+C copies, Ctrl+D duplicates, Delete removes, X lets go.
ui.architect.mark_hint: Drag on the ground from one corner of the plot to the other.
ui.architect.build_hint: Drag a piece from the pieces (C) onto the plot. Click a piece to pick it, drag it to move it.
ui.architect.view_keys: WASD moves the view, the right mouse button turns it, the mouse wheel brings it nearer or further.
ui.architect.keys: C opens the pieces. Click a piece to pick it, drag it to move it. Ctrl+V puts a copied piece down under the mouse. G changes the grid, B looks around, Esc leaves.
ui.architect.catalogue_hint: Drag a piece out onto the plot. C opens and closes the pieces.
ui.architect.fit.Outside: It does not fit on the plot here.
ui.architect.fit.TooHigh: It reaches above the plot's height here.
ui.architect.fit.NoGround: There is nothing here to stand it on.
ui.architect.too_big: A plot is at most {most} tiles a side. Mark a smaller one.
ui.architect.gold_invalid: Gold is a whole number from 0 to {most}.
ui.architect.height_invalid: The height is a whole number of metres from 1 to {most}.
ui.architect.looking: Looking around. Press B to go back to architect mode.
